scope: Acquisition limits only; no new observation, modified weight or CSV value
endpoint_sufficiency: Only one city changes; its own exclusion cannot coexist with exclusion of a baseline-possible competitor. All-low and all-high corners maximize the two types respectively.
joint_threshold_scope: Common-coordinate sufficient thresholds, not necessary thresholds for arbitrary joint evidence; strict separation needed, ties remain possible.

zurich_PTR_conditioning.exact_observation_scope: Only Zurich PTR becomes exact; all other139 nonfullymissing and20 otherfullymissing cells remain unchanged
zurich_PTR_conditioning.monotonic_gap: Zurich regret decreases with its lower utility; every other regret is nondecreasing with its upper utility. The gap is nonincreasing in either bound.

exact_ptr_switch.interval_sufficient_conditions: PTR upper below threshold guarantees Zurich; PTR lower above threshold guarantees Singapore. Straddling intervals need the full two-bound calculation.
